column2: The  general  objects  for  which  the  Corporation  is

column1: constituted are hereby declared to be—

column2: to  complete  the  sacred  Kotmale  Mahaweli  Maha
Seya,  which  is  presently  under  construction  and
carry out maintenance and rehabilitation thereof;
to  ensure  and  facilitate  the  performance  of
traditional  Buddhist  and  cultural  rituals  at
Mahaweli Maha Seya;
to  hold  exhibitions,  lectures,  seminars  and  make
publications  in  order  to  promote  awareness  about
the objectives of the Corporation;
to  act  for  the  benefit  of  Buddhist  institutions  all

over  Sri  Lanka  giving  priority 
to  Central
Province where the sacred Mahaweli Maha Seya is
situated;
to take every possible step to assist the progress of
the Buddha Sasana;
to  protect  Buddhism  and  popularize  the  righteous
life style preached therein, among Buddhists;
to  improve  the  educational  activities  of  Buddhist
children and to improve their spiritual values;
to  establish  friendly  relationships  with  Buddhist
organizations both in Sri Lanka and abroad;
to protect cultural identities of Buddhists.
